title: Border czar says ICE agents not "found guilty of anything inappropriate" amid raids
summary: Tom Homan, the Trump administration's border czar, spoke to CBS News about the deadly ICE shooting in Minneapolis. When asked if ICE uses excessive force, Homan said, "I haven't seen one...ICE officer found guilty of anything inappropriate." He added he's not involved in every arrest, but trusts ICE and border control agents.
